question: There are 13 members in group A, 10 members in group B and 45 members in group C. All the members of these groups went to a restaurant. The average amount spent on each member of group A, B and C is ₹367, ₹112 and ₹401, respectively. The total average amount (in ₹) spent per member is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let assumed average be ₹350.

⇒ Net deviation = 13×(+17) + 10×(−238) + 45×(+51)

⇒ Net deviation = 221 − 2380 + 2295 = +136

⇒ Average change = +136 ÷ 68 = +2

⇒ Actual Average = 350 + 2 = 352

**∴ The correct answer is ₹352.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
